description: Ports de Catalunya - Infraestructures portuàries is a dataset listed in Generalitat de Catalunya open data portal (analisi.transparenciacatalunya.cat), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Generalitat de Catalunya. Llista de les infraestructures portuàries existents a Catalunya amb el nom del gestor, les seves diferents tipologies d'ús i el punt de referència d'ubicació. Coverage: Catalonia. The portal files it under the category Urbanisme-infraestructures. Its tags are dades_de_referència. The table has 13 columns. Attribution on the portal: Catàleg Tècnic de Dades. Direcció General de Transports i Mobilitat. Departament. The portal shows 2026-07-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-analisi-transparenciacatalunya-cat-portal.
